title: finding(plugin-detail): the related-list TOOLBAR has no ADR-0066 D4 capability gate — `RelatedToolbarButton` reads only `visible`, while the object-list toolbar one surface over filters `list_toolbar` through `mayInvoke`
body:
Dedup keywords: `related list toolbar` · `list_toolbar` · `requiredPermissions` · `RelatedToolbarButton` · `capability gate`

Surfaced in the `out_of_scope_findings` of the objectui#9623 dev report and **independently re-measured at source by the dispatching `domain:ui#2` seat** (`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) before filing. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production. Class **(b)** — violates a declared contract.

## The fact, re-derived on `origin/main` by this seat, ⛔ not taken from the report

Two surfaces render `list_toolbar` actions. One applies the ADR-0066 D4 capability gate and one does not.

| probe on `origin/main` | reading |
|:--|:--|
| SUBJECT — `requiredPermissions` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` | **0 hits** |
| ⭐ lit control — `useCondition` in that same file | **3 hits** ⇒ the zero is about the subject, ⛔ not a dead query |
| ⭐ control 2 — the file exists on the ref | `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` present |
| the sibling that DOES gate | `packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx:151` takes `useCapabilityGate()`, and `:160` filters with `actionRendersAt(a, 'list_toolbar') && mayInvoke(a?.requiredPermissions)` |
| that RelatedList really serves this location | `RelatedList.tsx:146` and `:1702` derive the child object's `list_toolbar` actions; `:341` spreads each action's `visible` predicate and nothing else |

⇒ the related-list header evaluates **only** `action.visible`. A `list_toolbar` action declaring a `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks renders anyway, one surface over from a toolbar that hides it.

## The declared contract it misses

`@objectstack/spec`, `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` — `requiredPermissions` is *"Enforced with 403 on the platform action route (script/flow/modal + MCP) and **mirrored as a UI hide**"*. "Mirrored as a UI hide" is declared behaviour; this header does not mirror it.

## Relationship to the cards around it

- **objectui#9623 / PR objectui#9776** repaired the ROW half of exactly this gap — `DataTableRowActionsMenu` now filters `rowActionDefs` through `mayInvoke`. ⛔ This toolbar half was correctly NOT folded in: different file, different package (`plugin-detail` vs `components`), and it would add a whole new verification surface.
- **objectui#9572** (`DeclaredActionsBar` has no D4 gate) is the same family again. ⇒ ⭐ **three surfaces, one declared contract**; whoever grades this should look at all three together, because the population is now the interesting fact rather than any single site.
- ⚠️ **Not a second instance:** the mobile branch of `RelatedList` renders `object-gallery` rather than `data-table` and carries no row actions at all. Recorded so the next reader does not go hunting for one.

## What must be measured before a fix is designed

⚠️ ⛔ Not mechanical. `useCapabilityGate` fails **OPEN** on unknown while the toolbar's `visible` predicate is fail-**closed**, and objectui#9572 records that these two conventions 「do not agree on by default」. The same boundary question applies here. ⛔ A fix that simply drops `mayInvoke` in beside `visible` may be wrong at the boundary, and the answer should be consistent across all three surfaces rather than decided a third time locally.

⛔ Also out of bounds, for the same reason it was on objectui#9623: this is a **UI mirror** of a decision the server still enforces. ⛔ Enforcement must not move into the UI.
